name: promptland
title: Promptland ✎ prompt library
description: Store and share prompts. Build-style wallet auth (browser MetaMask, local in-browser seed wallet, or password-derived key — challenge/verify + HMAC bearer sessions); each wallet keeps a private library, and shared prompts are CID-pinned to localfs so anyone can browse the gallery or import by CID.

/owner.docs: Owner address and whether one is claimed yet

/auth/challenge.docs: Sign-in challenge for ?address= — returns the message the wallet must sign

/auth/verify.docs: {address, signature, message} → {token, address, role}. First signer ever claims ownership (~/.mod/promptland/owner.json); everyone else signs in as a user with their own library

/prompts.docs: List the caller's prompts, or upsert one: {id?, name, description?, tags?, body}

/prompts/{id}.docs: Read or delete one of the caller's prompts

/prompts/{id}/share.docs: Pin the prompt to localfs → CID, and list it in the public gallery

/shared.docs: Public gallery of shared prompts (CID + metadata)

/shared/{cid}.auth: GET: false, DELETE: author or owner
/shared/{cid}.docs: Read a shared prompt by CID (public), or delist it from the gallery

/import.docs: {cid} → copy a shared prompt into the caller's library
